subs.note: Ippolito Baccusi. The movements of the mass, each on its own.

items.title: Kyrie (Baccusi, Missa Quando lieta sperai)
items.desc: Ippolito Baccusi, Missa Quando lieta sperai, Kyrie, before 1589. 5 voices (Cantus, Quintus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
